summary: Recorded receipt ad511acf2fed45ae90f30f200ec3d4d1, the repeat of the fixed fsync experiment from its retained inputs. The second run of the same file-write-plus-fsync harness inverted 69 of 200 attempts with 402 term writes, a mean write of 2.45 ms and a maximum of 7.2 ms, against the earlier run's 89 inversions with a mean near 2 ms and a maximum near 16 ms. The account keeps its violated conclusion and asserted defect claim and now cites two independent runs for the claim that the inversion occurs under genuine file-system latency rather than an injected sleep; the counterevidence entry on that receipt is extended with the second measurement, and a new limitation states that both runs sit on one container filesystem with the same sync mode, so the reproduction shows the exposure is stable on this platform rather than establishing a field rate. The joint history notes that this is a repeat of the same fixed experiment sharing its case, admission and assertion and differing only in storage timings, and both heartbeat knowledge entries gain the receipt, knowledge-0 on the case event and knowledge-1 on the result event.
